metadata.case_name: CHAN PAK LEUNG v. LEE KIN TAK AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: The injuries to the plaintiff’s right leg after the accident necessitated the right leg to be amputated 16 cm below the knee.
source: The injuries to the plaintiff’s right leg after the accident necessitated the right leg to be amputated 16 cm below the knee.
There was marked wasting of right thigh muscle.
The plaintiff was assessed to have 28% impairment of the whole person.

As far as residual disability is concerned, the plaintiff has recurrent pain in the amputated right leg. He also needs walking aid for prolonged walking. He is unable to run, jump, climb or squat and cannot carry heavy weight.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation at level between right knee and ankle

manifestations.description: With a prosthesis fitted to the amputation stump, the plaintiff could walk without crutches but with a limp.
